tagline: Welcome to my little corner on the Internet.
quote: It ain't about how hard you hit, it's about how hard you can get hit and keep moving forward.
bio: My name is **Yash Jain**. Professionally, I work as a consultant, and my hobbies include writing, watching films, running, and travelling.

I was born and brought up in Delhi. I pursued my bachelor's from [SSCBS (DU)](https://sscbs.du.ac.in/) and did my MBA from [IIM Ahmedabad](https://www.iima.ac.in/). I have worked/interned at firms such as [BCG](https://www.bcg.com/), [HealthQuad (VC)](https://www.healthquad.in/), [General Catalyst](https://www.generalcatalyst.com/), and most recently [Roland Berger](https://www.rolandberger.com/).
I write to make sense of the world and this page reflects my beliefs (ever-changing) about business, world, and life in general.
